notes.title: Build 210605
notes.notes:
Further performance improvements:
  - reduced number of pixel lights per object
  - slightly reduced shadow resolution
In some of the future updates, players will be able to choose between "Performance" mode with deferred rendering enabled that provides best performance and "Quality" mode that uses forward rendering, has no visual artifacts while offering less stable performance.

notes.title: Words of Appreciation to our Community
notes.notes:
First of all, thank you so much for all your feedback and involvement from launch!

Last week was fantastic! We were really touched to see such a dedicated following.

We already provided a few patches but we still need to address some issues. 
Over the course of the next month we will provide even more updates and further improve gameplay experience.

By that time Here I Come will be ready to go on sale. And for those who want to make a review or want to get a better taste of Here I Come we plan to to host a free giveaway event in the future (no exact date yet but hopefully as soon as we introduce our new game). We believe that this will let even more players to become a part of our community.

Thank you so much for being with us on this journey, and helping to make Here I Come better!

Crystar Games
